profile.headline: Payment Account Executive - Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Medium to high risk US payment processing. I work with a lot of foreign and European operators to help them with US acquiring and stable MIDs. My favorites are digital products and services like online courses and content with subscriptions, AI, dating, and Saas. But I do work with Nutra and ecommerce. 

8+ years in payment sales and merchant services and 4+ years in software development in the crypto industry. 

I’m a generalist with an early foundation in internet marketing, a finance background, extensive sales experience, and several years of hands-on software development. Now I focus on networking with medium-high risk clients and payment companies and less time on "building" software. 

I box, lift weights, enjoy music events, and go on adventures. I have retired from competitive basketball. 

Pretty good with people and social dynamics.

positions.description: Built the easiest way to install and run OpenClaw AI agents for non-technical users

positions.title: Product Developer
positions.description:
- Built and shipped an e2e Polymarket tracking + analytics platform with LLMs, owning architecture, UI/UX, backend services, DB design, and DevOps. 
Conducted market research on prediction market industry and specified product build requirements and MVP scope

- Implemented payments, auth, and real-time notifications to support subscriptions and user management

- Design data ingestion and polling pipeline for on-chain market data; normalized and stored events for analytics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a React Native crypto payment app with merchant cash-back features using Solana Pay 

- Designed and shipped 0→1 DAO pre‑governance UI and pre‑proposal flows for a decision platform (Solana Hackathon)

- Delivered the homepage and portfolio tracking UI for a Solana trading platform, including wallet connect, real‑time charts, and a trading panel
positions.insights: Skills: solana · Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) · Next.js

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Deep Ink Ventures is a ventures studio based in Berlin, Germany 
https://medium.com/web3foundation/decentralized-futures-introducing-deep-ink-ventures-2e4919eb4e22

Lead frontend developer for grant-funded Web3 infrastructure. 

Built 3 open-source applications from scratch using Next.js, TypeScript, React, and Tailwind.

GenesisDAO (Polkadot) – DAO creation platform with proposal voting and multisig governance. Funded by Web3 Foundation.

Elio DAO (Stellar/Soroban) – DAO creation tool for Stellar's smart contract program. Funded by Stellar Development Foundation.

MultiClique (Stellar/Soroban) – Multisignature wallet for creating and approving multi-party transactions. 

Combined grants: $250K+ across Web3 Foundation and Stellar ecosystem programs.

https://github.com/deep-ink-ventures
https://deep-ink.ventures/

positions.title: Director of Sales and Marketing
positions.description:
Helped build a new product from 0 and sold the product via door to door and cold-calling. Then I recruited and trained salespeople to do the same. 

Personally acquired 120+ point-of-sale clients responsible for $240,000 annual residual revenue and increased portfolio book value by $720,000 while managing a team of 5 salespersons 

Contributed to a product design for a new payment technology that allows cash-discount and surcharge programs to be implemented according to Visa/MasterCard guidelines and state laws

Led the majority of the company’s payment technology and point-of-sale trainings

Successfully negotiated with 2 payment technology partners for cross-selling and improved revenue per deal by 30%

positions.title: Director of Business Development
positions.description:
A lot of door to door and cold-calling

Managed a sales team that acquired 600+ clients totaling in $170+ MM processing volume to date

Helped grow the company from a 10 people office in 2012 to 70 people in four offices across the nation in 2017
